source.notes: Wizard-driven metadata. Common entries preserve original candidates/units; remaining detailed reference entries are generated from their proto so the VS Code engine has broad coverage.

ptp.name: ptp
ptp.desc: 点到点运动（自动选关节/直线）

print.name: print
print.desc: 打印输出，支持多参数/文件输出/精度控制

init.name: init
init.desc: 恢复系统变量为默认值

offset.name: offset
offset.desc: 位姿偏移（世界/工件坐标系下）
offset.proto: pose offset(pose p, double dx, double dy, double dz, double rz, double ry, double rx)

reltool.name: reltool
reltool.desc: 工具坐标系下位姿偏移
reltool.proto: pose reltool(pose p, double dx, double dy, double dz, double rz, double ry, double rx)

jump.name: jump
jump.desc: 跳跃运动（带拾取高度控制）

velset.name: velset
velset.desc: 速度调节，设置速度倍率和最大速度

scan.name: scan
scan.desc: 扫描输入字符串，按分隔符解析至变量
scan.desc_en: Scan string by delimiter to variables

palletcompen.name: palletcompen
palletcompen.proto: pose palletcompen(pallet, double X_offset, double Y_offset, pose P)

setinterpercent.name: setinterpercent
setinterpercent.desc: 设置机器人运行速度倍率

getinterpercent.name: getinterpercent
getinterpercent.desc: 获取机器人当前运行速度倍率

syncdo.name: syncdo
syncdo.desc: 同步设置数字量输出（随运动同步）

pulsedo.name: pulsedo
pulsedo.proto: void pulsedo(int chan, bool value, double width)

setpwm.name: setpwm
setpwm.proto: bool setpwm(int channel, int freq, int ratio)

if.name: if
if.desc: 条件判断，满足时执行块内代码

elseif.name: elseif
elseif.desc: 前一条件不满足时检查此条件
elseif.desc_en: Check this condition when previous is false

else.name: else
else.desc: 所有 if/elseif 条件均不满足时的默认分支
else.desc_en: Default branch when all conditions false

while.name: while
while.desc: 当条件成立时循环，先判断后执行

for.name: for
for.proto: for(初始化; bool表达式; 迭代)

repeat.name: repeat
repeat.desc: 直到型循环起始，先执行后判断

until.name: until
until.desc: 直到型循环结束条件，表达式为真时退出

loop.name: loop
loop.desc: 无限循环起始，需配合 break 退出

endloop.name: endloop
endloop.desc: 结束 loop 无限循环块

switch.name: switch
switch.desc: 多分支判断，根据表达式值匹配 case

default.name: default
default.desc: switch 无匹配 case 时的默认分支
default.desc_en: Default branch when no case matches

endswitch.name: endswitch
endswitch.desc: 结束 switch 多分支块

continue.name: continue
continue.desc: 跳过本次循环剩余代码，直接进入下一次循环

goto.name: goto
goto.desc: 无条件跳转到指定标签处执行

cjoint.name: cjoint
cjoint.desc: 获取机器人当前各轴位置

getpose.name: getpose
getpose.desc: 运动学正解：由轴位置求TCP位姿
getpose.proto: pose getpose(joint j, tool t, wobj w)

getjoint.name: getjoint
getjoint.desc: 运动学逆解：由TCP位姿求轴位置
getjoint.proto: joint getjoint(pose p, tool t, wobj w)

substr.name: substr
substr.proto: string substr(string s, int startpos, int len)

savesv.name: savesv
savesv.desc: 存储系统变量至配置文件
savesv.desc_en: Save system variable to config file
